hook.name: Hook
hook.job: Make you stay. You and AI built a whole business, and it looks done.

problem.name: Problem
problem.job: Show the mistakes everywhere, then the screenshot, crop, paste, prompt loop that never ends.

turn.name: Turn
turn.job: Answer the question. The red dots become Nextshot, and the sketch turns into the brand look.

how.name: How
how.job: Teach the first capture: shortcut, select, circle, answer.

session.name: Session
session.job: The key idea: many screens and many kinds of marks go into one session.

handoff.name: Hand-off
handoff.job: The payoff: one handoff with all the context, in a package built for AI agents.

close.name: Close
close.job: Show the fixed stand, clean and on brand, then tell you what to do next.

built.see: Yellow paper. A web page for the stand draws in first, with no voice for 1.2 seconds: "Lemonaid", "$9 a cup", a tiny Buy button. A robot labeled "AI" and a stick figure labeled "you" draw in. Then four more things they built pop in, each with a hand-written label: an app, legal docs, an email, and a marketing flyer.

flawed.see: The figure squints. Seven red dots pop, one per mistake: the sign, the price, the tiny Buy button, an app button off the screen, "Refunds: never!!" in the legal docs, "Grand opneing!" in the email, and a lime on the flyer.

loop.see: Everything dims, and a big figure steps up front. A white flash makes a screenshot of the page. Crop marks snap around the price, and the picture trims to them. An AI chat box draws in, the crop drops into it, and a prompt starts to type.

explain.see: The prompt gets long and messy: "the button. no, the OTHER one.", "left of that. smaller. by the lemon?", "no wait...". Red question marks pop over the figure, and sweat drops appear.

again.see: A tally climbs to ten. Six more pages, each with a red dot, pile up. The figure droops.

ask.see: The clutter clears and the first picture comes back with all seven red dots. On "all", the dots fly to the center and gather in one cluster.

meet.see: The red cluster becomes the Nextshot icon. A teal circle grows from the center and turns the screen into the dark Nextshot look. The word "Nextshot" rises in.

g.see: The menu bar slides in at the top, and the lemonade page appears as a clean web page. Option, Shift, and F keycaps press one by one. A crosshair drags a selection over the page, and a white flash marks the capture.

h.see: A C keycap shows, and red numbered badges 1, 2, 3 pop onto the sign, the price, and the Buy button. A Command+S keycap shows. The note panel slides in with "Circle 1 (1 of 3): what should change?" and a zoomed preview of the whole sign word. "Spell it Lemonade." types in while a mic icon pulses. The menu bar shows "Nshot (1)". Then "Circle 2 (2 of 3)" and "Make it $3."

i.see: The first capture shrinks into a "Session: feedback" tray on the left. A Checkout page and a Flavors page appear, and each flashes white as it is captured.

j.see: Marks land on the new pages: a circle on "Cash only", a box around the Total, an arrow at the "Coming soon" slot, and a general note, "Keep the fonts." Both pages drop into the tray. The menu bar counts up to "Nshot (3)". The tray slides to the center, and a zoom lens shows "Nshot (3)".

handoff.see: A cursor opens the Nshot menu and clicks "Copy Session Prompt". The menu closes. Large brand type says "3 captures. 7 notes. 1 prompt." and a teal line draws under it.

paste.see: An agent window rises with one pasted message: <feedback_bundle captures="3" items="6">, the Goal line, three thumbnails, and the six items grouped by page. The chips light up: Claude Code, Codex, Any agent. The window slides left, and a "Built for AI agents" panel lists four parts: Numbered marks, Screen text, Right-sized images, Plan first.

tagline.see: The agent window and the menu bar fade. The fixed stand appears as a clean web page: "Lemonade", "$3 a cup", and a big Buy button. Teal check marks pop where the three red badges were. The Nextshot icon and name pop in on the right. The end card fills in: "Mark it up. Hand it off." with a teal underline, Option Shift F keycaps with "starts a capture", "Get the DMG in this message.", and "Feedback stays on your Mac until you paste it." It holds in silence to the end.

cues.items: App, docs, email, flyer pop in
cues.paste1: Crop drops into the AI chat
cues.wipe: Teal wipe to the Nextshot look

music: A plucked-string loop of four chords (C, G, A minor, F). It fades in over the first second, plays sparse quarter notes in the sketch part, and fills out at "Now you can". It drops to about half volume while the voice speaks. One long chord rings out under the end card.
